question: Could you analyze our data and identify which ten-year period starting from any movie release year present in the data had the largest number of films, considering consecutive ten-year periods beginning at each unique year? Only output the start year and the total count for that specific period.
sql:
WITH valid_years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT TRY_CAST(year AS INTEGER) AS release_year
  FROM Movie
  WHERE year ~ '^\d{4}$'
),
period_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    v.release_year AS start_year,
    COUNT(m.index) AS film_count
  FROM valid_years v
  LEFT JOIN Movie m ON TRY_CAST(m.year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN v.release_year AND v.release_year + 9
  GROUP BY v.release_year
)
SELECT start_year, film_count
FROM period_counts
ORDER BY film_count DESC
LIMIT 1
